rows.label: tlk43420171_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Sure is a good thing my
Blade's so powerful!

rows.label: tlk43420171_02_msg0002
rows.name:
The other day, my Blade
found someone who had fallen
onto Acedia's back.

rows.label: tlk43420171_02_msg0003
rows.name:
That refugee was from the camp and got
upset, saying no help from a Blade was
needed...

rows.label: tlk43420171_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But we couldn't just leave the refugee
there, so we carried that person back
by force!
